newsitem.title: USA: Tetra Tech wins $10.5 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Tetra Tech wins $10.5 million contract.

text.p: Tetra Tech Inc on Friday said it has signed a three-year, $10.5 million contract with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency to provide engineering and scientific services for water management.
The company will support the EPA nationwide focusing on water resource quality of regional river basins. The support will focus on controlling non-point source pollution.
In addition, the company will conduct water quality computer modeling, economic analysis, as well as technical training and community outreach.
Tetra Tech shares were up 5/8 to 15 by midday.
